study_user_attrs.search_space_notes: Third-party TTVAE (transformer VAE + MMD), state as positional argv[0], data resolved repo-relative (data/pums_states/<ST> == ctx.data_dir via the data/ -> SSD symlink; no --data-dir flag). --sample-method triangular is the paper's PUBLISHED sampling (encode real rows, Dirichlet convex combos of posterior latents, decode with contextual h) and is the main audited arm -- HPO searches under it; the prior arm (z~N(0,I), h_ctx=0) is produced at finalize time from the same checkpoint with --sample-method prior, never searched separately. Space ported verbatim from the old harness (experiments/hpo/search_spaces.py). Trials never pass --ensemble, so the trainer skips the K=50 loop, keeps <out_root>/<run_name>/metrics.json and never opens the reference split.
